item.title: 4 jobs you can hand to an AI this week
item.description: Welcome to the first BotsDoThat Weekly. Each week we pick a few real, practical jobs people are handing to AI, tell you what you end up with, and give you a prompt you can copy. No hype, no made-up numbers. In this issue: Have an agent research a used car from its listing link; Have an agent contact tradespeople and line up quotes for a home project; Send a long video or thread to your bot with one reply; Set spend limits and usage alerts on your AI accounts.
